as_told.title: Chilean case: plane wrongly ruled out

plain: A well-known UFO skeptic, Mick West, talks about a dramatic video of a strange object filmed by the Chilean Navy, which a journalist, Leslie Kean, made public in the news site the Huffington Post in 2016 or 2017. West says it turned out to be a distant airplane, and that official investigators had spent two years ruling things out and still got it wrong. He tells it as a warning that even careful official studies can mistake ordinary things for mysteries.
